Resolves #19629

The operator challenged #19624's wording. `neo-agent-brain` is the Agent OS, the backend (MCP servers, graph, Dream Mode). `neo-agent-institution` is the Fleet Manager, the app that starts the harnesses. Nobody lives in the Agent OS. The six footers now read: "Neo.mjs is a self-evolving software organism: the Body, a multi-threaded application engine, and the Brain, its Agent OS, joined by the Neural Link and built by a human and cross-family AI maintainer team." `the-salute.md` keeps its model list. The sentence places the team nowhere, so it holds whatever the canonical definition settles on.

Evidence: L1 (a docs-only sentence swap, six files, one line each) → L1 required. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: docs. One sentence in six files, no other change.
